&nbsp;

The unit tests employed by the 'broadcast' package have a test coverage of over 95%.  
For the sake of transparency, the unit tests coverage report, produced by the [covr](https://github.com/r-lib/covr) package, is provided here:

```{r, comment="", results="asis", echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
load("covr.RData")
print(covr_broadcast)

```
